paper.title_en: Double integral representation in the invariant masses of a composite system and nonperturbative calculation of the asymptotics of light-meson electromagnetic form factors
paper.abstract_en: We obtain nonperturbative asymptotic expansions of the electromagnetic form factors of the pi and rho mesons at large spacelike momentum transfer, Q^2->∞. The calculation is based on a double integral representation in the invariant masses of the composite system. The model parameters are kept at the values fixed in the authors' earlier description of meson electroweak properties. We show that, in the limit of vanishing constituent-quark mass, with the constituent quarks taken to be pointlike, the asymptotic ratio of the longitudinally polarized rho-meson to pion form factors in the helicity basis is consistent with the prediction of perturbative QCD (pQCD) within the adopted parameter ranges.
